Home.tagline: Create VietQR payment codes in seconds.
Home.subtitle: Pick a bank, enter the details and download a QR code any Vietnamese banking app can scan.

Status.label: API status
Status.outdated: API v{apiVersion} is older than the client expects (v{expected}). Some features may not work.

Studio.title: Studio
Studio.intro: Create a VietQR code: choose a bank, enter the payment details and download the image.

note.static: No amount: the payer enters it in their banking app.
note.dynamic: Carries a fixed amount that the payer cannot change.

hints.size: 100 to 2000. Applies to the QR only template. Default 500.

errors.unknownBank: Choose a bank from the list.
errors.notPositive: The amount must be greater than 0.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Fill in the form and press Generate to see your QR code here.

qrTypeNote.static: A static QR carries no amount; the payer enters it.
qrTypeNote.dynamic: A dynamic QR carries the amount above.

copy.failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
copy.embedWarning: Privacy: the image URL contains the account number in plain text. Anyone with the URL can see it.

codes.99: Something went wrong on our side or the service is unreachable. Please try again later.
codes.01: Some required information is missing. Fill in all fields and try again.
codes.02: The amount is not valid. Enter a whole number of VND within the allowed range.
codes.03: One of the values is not valid. Check your input and try again.
codes.04: We could not find that bank. Choose a bank from the list.
codes.06: We could not read a QR code from that image. Try a clearer, larger image.
codes.07: This Payload is not a valid VietQR Payload.

Banks.title: Banks
Banks.intro: Banks supported by VietQR. Pick one to start a QR in Studio.
Banks.searchHint: Search by name, short name, code or BIN

Inspect.title: Inspect a QR
Inspect.intro: Paste a payload or upload a QR image to see what it says.

payload.label: Payload
payload.hint: The text a VietQR code encodes, ending in a 4-character checksum.

image.label: QR image
image.drop: Drop a QR image here, or choose a file
image.hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP or GIF, up to {limit}.

upload.tooLarge: That file is too large. The limit is {limit}.
upload.notImage: That file is not an image.

crc.invalidDetail: This payload's checksum does not match. The code may be damaged or edited, and a banking app may refuse it.

errors.notVietQr: This is not a valid VietQR code. Check the payload, including its checksum.
errors.decodeFailed: Could not read a QR code from this image.

Pay.title: Pay
Pay.noAmount: No fixed amount. This is a static QR: enter the amount yourself in your banking app.

verify.title: Check before you pay
verify.body: Anyone can create this page for any account. Confirm the bank, account number and amount with the recipient before you transfer.

errors.missing: This link does not contain any payment details. Ask the recipient to send you the link again.
errors.invalidTitle: This payment link is not valid
errors.invalid: Some details in the link are missing or wrong. Do not pay; ask the recipient for a new link.
